responsibility: This header defines the fundamental data structures and APIs for constructing and managing RTL during function expansion. It declares rtl_data and incoming_args state, sequence and insn-chain accessors, address-adjustment and memory-reference rewriting helpers, constant and vector constructors, mem-attribute setters, insn-copy and location APIs, and other low-level services used pervasively by expression, statement, call, and target-expansion code.
same_name_distinction: Interface header in the `emit-rtl` group: it declares RTL state structures and helper APIs for insn/operand construction, whereas `gcc/emit-rtl.cc` contains the backing implementation and global RTL machinery.
